core_identity.title: Tennis camp at Park Hotel Zanzanù
core_identity.description: Group tennis camp on seven clay courts high above the north-west shore of Lake Garda, with lake-view rooms, half board and a spa at the four-star Park Hotel Zanzanù. Choose a 4-, 5- or 8-day package; coaching is in groups of three or four.

schedule_notes: Runs daily from late March to late October. The 2026 season ended on 20 October; 2027 dates are not published yet.

pricing.price_notes: 4 days from €401, 5 days from €515, 8 days from €797, per person in a double room with half board.

core_identity.title: Nike Adult Tennis Camp at Stanford
core_identity.description: A three-day adult camp at Stanford's Arrillaga Tennis Center, run by Stanford assistant coach and former ATP player Brandon Coupe. Players are grouped by level, from beginners to advanced.

pricing.price_notes: $644 for the 3-day camp; a deposit holds your place. Adults 18+.

core_identity.title: Mouratoglou High-Performance Weekend
core_identity.description: Friday-to-Sunday camp built on the Mouratoglou Methodology: technique, tactics, fitness and structured match play, three hours each morning. Open to all levels.

pricing.price_notes: $540 per 3-day weekend (9 hours of instruction). Custom group camps on request.

core_identity.title: Grass-court doubles clinic at St George's Hill
core_identity.description: A one-day doubles clinic on four side-by-side natural grass courts at St George's Hill Lawn Tennis Club, following Jamie Murray's doubles programme. Five hours on court, six players per coach.

location.venue_name: St George's Hill Lawn Tennis Club

pricing.price_notes: £199 per day or £398 for both days. Open to players rating 2–6 on Active Away's self-rating guide.

core_identity.title: Doubles clinic at David Lloyd Finchley
core_identity.description: Five hours of doubles coaching in North London using the Jamie Murray programme. Book one day or both days of the weekend.

pricing.price_notes: £119 per day or £238 for the weekend.

core_identity.title: Tennis and padel weekend in Brighton
core_identity.description: A three-day seaside weekend at Hove Beach Park mixing 4.5 hours of tennis with 5.5 hours of padel coaching and match play, with group dinners booked in the evenings.

pricing.price_notes: £349 per person. Accommodation and meals are not included.

core_identity.title: Tennis week at Ikos Kissamos
core_identity.description: Seven nights at the five-star, all-inclusive Ikos Kissamos in western Crete with 22.5 hours of coaching. Six à la carte restaurants are included; non-players get £200 off.

pricing.price_notes: Per person based on two sharing; single occupancy from £5,029.

core_identity.title: Tennis week at Sani Beach
core_identity.description: A week on Halkidiki at Sani Resort, home of the Rafa Nadal Tennis Centre and its eight red clay courts. 22.5 hours of coaching, full board and dine-around access to the resort's restaurants.

pricing.price_notes: Per person based on two sharing. Non-players get £200 off.

core_identity.title: Tennis weekend at The Lensbury
core_identity.description: Two nights at the four-star Lensbury on the Thames in Teddington, with 11 hours of coaching built on Jamie Murray's programme and organised group meals.

pricing.price_notes: £549 per person in a classic double or twin room, bed and breakfast.

core_identity.title: Engage advanced camp in Oxford, Florida
core_identity.description: A two-day, 14-hour camp for 3.75–4.5 players focused on positioning, shot selection and point construction, with no more than eight players per coach.

pricing.price_notes: $650 per player. Skill bands are Engage's own 3.75–4.5 scale.

core_identity.title: Mark Price signature camp in Acworth
core_identity.description: Three-day coaching camp with PPA pro Mark Price and his staff: dinking, third and fifth shots, movement and defence, in two groups (3.0–3.5 and 3.5+) of up to 16 players.

pricing.price_notes: $395 per player.

core_identity.title: Nike Adult Pickleball Camp at TTC Palms
core_identity.description: A desert weekend camp with Bollettieri Pickleball in Palm Desert: over 10 hours of drills, strategy and match play, grouped from beginner to advanced. Day camp only.

pricing.price_notes: $744 per 3-day camp; lunch and housing not included.

core_identity.title: Doubles Lab in Palm Desert
core_identity.description: A one-day lab for established doubles teams led by Matthew Marceau: communication, positioning, movement patterns and team tactics in live play. Both partners register.

pricing.price_notes: $599 per player; you must attend with your doubles partner.

core_identity.title: Los Barriles pickleball festival
core_identity.description: Three mornings of clinics with Tyson McGuffin on the Sea of Cortez, with tournament warm-ups and level-matched recreational play.

pricing.price_notes: $1,499 per player, 8am–2pm each day. Travel and accommodation not included.

core_identity.title: Pickleball clinic week at Sandals La Toc
core_identity.description: Daily clinics with IPTPA master coaches John and Leesa Walker at Sandals Regency La Toc, an all-inclusive resort beneath the Pitons, plus mixers, round robins and a beach farewell dinner.

pricing.price_notes: From $3,699 per person, double occupancy. $400 deposit.

core_identity.title: Pickleball week at Club Med Turkoise
core_identity.description: Six nights on Grace Bay at the adults-only Club Med Turkoise with daily clinics from touring pros (six players per coach or better), level-matched play, trivia night and a catamaran trip.

pricing.price_notes: $3,380 per person sharing; $3,990 single. Balance due 30 December 2026.

core_identity.title: Empowher women's retreat in Punta Cana
core_identity.description: A women-only week with 9+ hours of daily clinics from top pros, themed nights and an all-inclusive resort stay. For players rated 3.0 to 4.5.

pricing.price_notes: $2,900 per person sharing; $3,200 single. Sold out, waitlist open.

core_identity.title: Pickleball break in Vilamoura
core_identity.description: Three nights at the Hyatt Regency Vilamoura near the beach and marina, with 11 hours of structured pickleball, four players per court and planned group dinners.

pricing.price_notes: Per person sharing, bed and breakfast.

core_identity.title: Padel & Fitness Camp at Rafa Nadal Academy
core_identity.description: A Sunday-to-Sunday week in Manacor with 12 hours of padel in groups of four and 5 hours of padel-specific fitness, staying at the academy's residence. Groups are set by level on day one.

schedule_notes: Bookable year-round, Sunday to Sunday, subject to availability. A 4-night half-week is also offered.

pricing.price_notes: From €960 per week including 7 nights at the Rafa Nadal Residence (price as listed by The Padel Circle; the academy quotes on request).

core_identity.title: M3 Padel Week in Madrid
core_identity.description: A Monday-to-Friday intensive in Madrid with high-level coaches, classes adapted to every level and optional hotel packages.

pricing.price_notes: €1,450 training only; €2,000 with 5 nights at Exe Getafe; €2,900 with 5 nights at Hard Rock Hotel Madrid.

core_identity.title: Padel week at Emilio Sánchez Academy
core_identity.description: Weekly and weekend padel programmes in Barcelona with English-speaking coaches. The Gold week adds an hour of fitness to two hours on court each day.

schedule_notes: Weekly programmes run Monday to Friday and weekend programmes Friday to Sunday, year-round.

pricing.price_notes: Weekly: Gold €930, Silver €660. Weekend: Gold €603, Silver €396. Taxes included.

core_identity.title: Premier Padel Finals clinic in Barcelona
core_identity.description: Four days of FIP-method coaching (12+ hours, four players per court) with video analysis, an internal tournament, and a Category A ticket to the Premier Padel Finals at Palau Sant Jordi.

pricing.price_notes: €890 per person. Accommodation not included.

core_identity.title: Padel clinic at Advantage Padel Nottingham
core_identity.description: A one-day clinic on four reserved indoor courts, with separate beginner and intermediate programmes and four players per coach.

pricing.price_notes: £229 per person. 6 March and 4 December are beginner days; 7 March is intermediate.

core_identity.title: Padel clinic at Great Western, Glasgow
core_identity.description: Four hours of coaching on the Louie Harris programme, four players per court, with a beginner day and an intermediate day.

pricing.price_notes: £159 per person. 10 July is for beginners, 11 July for intermediates.

core_identity.title: Padel long weekend in Barcelona
core_identity.description: Three nights at the four-star AC Hotel Victoria Suites with 12.5 hours of coached padel over four days, four players per coach in the mornings.

location.venue_name: AC Hotel Victoria Suites by Marriott

pricing.price_notes: From £999 per person sharing, bed and breakfast; the April date is £1,079.

core_identity.title: Padel break in Vilamoura
core_identity.description: Three nights at the Hyatt Regency Vilamoura with coached padel sessions and group dinners, a short walk from the marina.

pricing.price_notes: From £849 per person sharing, bed and breakfast.

core_identity.title: Padel week at Nana Golden Beach
core_identity.description: A week at the five-star, all-inclusive Nana Golden Beach on Crete with 22 hours of padel coaching, match play and tournaments, and a court for every four players.

pricing.price_notes: £1,829 per person sharing, all inclusive.
